summary: Relate angular state to bob motion and distinguish small-angle approximation.
objective: Simulate a pendulum with angle, angular velocity and a period comparison for small amplitudes.
example_prompts: Simulate a pendulum with angle, angular velocity and a period comparison for small amplitudes.

entities.name: Support and pivot
entities.guidance: Model a stable support, visible suspension point and a thin string terminating at the bob center.

entities.name: Bob
entities.guidance: Use a compact weighted-looking body with subdued metal finish; declare its geometry visual while mass is concentrated at a point.

entities.name: State overlays
entities.guidance: Show angular displacement, tangent velocity and gravity arrows on distinct scales.

state_contract.model: Ideal point bob, fixed length L>0, g>0; angle theta from downward vertical, angular velocity omega; theta acceleration=-(g/L)sin(theta).
state_contract.authority: One canonical model owns semantic values; derive geometry and labels from it. Keep presentation transforms separate.
actions: Set length and initial angle while stopped.

invariants: Small-angle period comparison uses 2*pi*sqrt(L/g) and is labeled approximate.
Paused state and simulation time do not advance.
motion_guidance: Use a documented fixed-step integrator, not a sinusoid mislabeled as the nonlinear solution.
Render bob position from angle; derive tangential velocity and acceleration from the same state.
known_limits: No air drag, pivot friction, string elasticity or slack-string motion.
Exclude amplitudes or initial speeds that invalidate the taut-string assumption; no collision-driven pendulum here.
Authored guidance; no scene runtime or visual verification has run for this recipe.

claims.statement: An ideal simple pendulum obeys theta double-dot=-(g/L)sin(theta); its small-angle period is approximately 2*pi*sqrt(L/g).
claims.scope: Point bob and negligible string mass with a fixed pivot and taut length.

object_craft.structure: Model a stable support, visible suspension point and a thin string terminating at the bob center.
object_craft.material: Subdued metal-looking bob and support, matte cord and low-contrast reference arc; finish is illustrative, not a mass estimator.
object_craft.articulation: Cord pivots at the support; bob center derives from theta and L, with no independent bob oscillator.

physical_contract.scope: Ideal taut-string point pendulum in a clear scene; no collisions.
colliders: None; support is a fixed pivot constraint and scene must leave the bob arc unobstructed.
contact: No ground or bob-bob contacts; exclude such configurations.
physical_contract.timestep: Document fixed integrator step and convergence tolerance; pause does not accumulate hidden time.
checks: Compare small-amplitude period against analytic approximation.
Compare numerical energy drift against a declared tolerance for the chosen step.
